# Synthetic contract fixtures

All names and details here are fictional. No actual notebook photo, contact, customer, asset, or medical/service diagnosis is represented.

`maintenance-capture.json` demonstrates the client manifest shape. Its sizes and hashes are illustrative and have no associated media file. `maintenance-extraction.json` demonstrates an uncertainty-preserving model proposal. Neither is evidence of a live capture, model call, or handwriting benchmark.

Validate shape with the schemas in `packages/contracts`. Also check referenced page IDs, unique local mention IDs, quotes present in the matching transcription, and unresolved identity/date semantics. Real media acceptance requires separate actual source bytes and server hash checks.

Keep the private pilot corpus outside this public repository and out of public CI artifacts.
